propositions: A live Gerrit webhook-to-checkout-to-prompt dogfood probe must execute the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion through the deployed four-pass review pipeline to prove end-to-end behavior without offline mocks.

A positive-control patchset with a valid Pass-1 discovery/evidence refinement must emit no project-attributed finding, demonstrating the criterion's ability to abstain when the directive lacks requisite phase information.

A predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset must produce a project-attributed advisory finding carrying reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], and observable Pass-2/Pass-3 attributes (validity, impact, priority, decision, threshold, posture).

A final cleaned patchset containing only valid phase-compliant instructions must emit no project-criterion finding and must be the sole probe revision submitted to main with blocking_enabled=false and block_threshold=0.90 preserved throughout.

The probe must not tune or improvise new test cases; it uses the already-committed balanced-corpus FIRE case and documents all four sequential Gerrit patchset outcomes as artifact traces on the ticket.
Blocking promotion requires a separate future ticket backed by production review data; this story remains observational and does not enable blocking or change the rubric based on probe results.
